summary: An alarm clock you can't snooze your way out of. Each alarm rings until you prove you're awake: type a phrase you chose, or answer quick math and trivia questions. The volume stays locked at max until you solve it, and an optional wake-up check-in asks 'Are you awake?' a few minutes later, ringing again if you went back to sleep. Alarms are real system alarms with automatic backups. Alarmed Pro is a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription. Audience: heavy sleepers, students with early lectures, gym-goers. Style: dark night-sky, near-black #0A0A0C canvas with a single confident electric blue accent #4F83FF, bold short headlines, calm and premium, no clutter.
